item.title: Devlog 0001
item.description:
Order Up!

We here at Sleepy Puppy Studios have been hard at work on our first project, a deductive reasoning game set in a fictional kingdom at the outset of the modern age.

Play as the head steward of a finicky royal family, where you assemble a dinner menu for each night’s feast– deciding which attendees’ requests to fulfill and which to ignore– and accepting the rewards and consequences that come with this surprisingly impactful duty.
